lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The fort on the hill was abandoned before anyone in {village} was born. Someone lives in it now.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Legion tracks run to the gate. A patrol is camped in the outer yard, and it is not alone.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: On the steps of the keep sits a big man with a sword across his knees as long as a man is tall.

lines.speaker: gravemaw
lines.text: Another one with a voice in the hilt. I can hear it from here.

lines.speaker: mc
lines.text: I didn't come to fight you.

lines.speaker: gravemaw
lines.text: Nobody does. Get through the Legion first. Then we'll see whose blade is hungrier.
